newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil to build Mongstad low-benzene gasoline unit.
newsitem.headline: Statoil to build Mongstad low-benzene gasoline unit.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it will invest 90 million crowns in a plant at its Mongstad refinery near Bergen to reduce benzene content in gasoline to less than one percent.
The unit is due to begin operation in late 1997 or early 1998, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Statoil Mongstad produces about 2.5 million tonnes per year of gasoline.

The company said small adjustments to Mongstad's production process had already cut the refinery's benzene content in gasoline. Statoil began marketing gasoline with a maximum two percent benzene in eastern Norway last January.
The company's Kalundborg refinery in Denmark produces around one million tonnes per year of gasoline with a benzene content of two percent or less.

Statoil said the Mongstad project was in expectation of a lowering of European-wide regulations covering benzene in gasoline from five percent to two percent by 2000. Norwegian regulations currently limit benzene content to five percent.
